hard_case: the owner calls `mailer.send(...)` on an exported const object, so the test observes the call through `jest.spyOn(mailer, "send")` and a literal `toHaveBeenCalledWith`

truth.toolchain: node 22.22.0; jest 30.5.2, ts-jest 29.4.14, typescript 5.9.3; edit applied by hand and the test command run on the whole package

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: changes the value the changed line returns

reasoning: `mailer.send("order " + id)` becomes `mailer.send("order #" + id)`. The test spies on `mailer.send` and asserts `toHaveBeenCalledWith("order 7")`, which the edited argument `"order #7"` fails.
